failed.scenario: two tabs cannot silently replace a selected complete archive before saving, and reopening restores the full choice
failed.stage: Explicit reopening: goto('/') followed by goto('/#/restore')
failed.error: Timed out waiting for restoration words field; page snapshot remained editor

diagnosis: bootApp reads location.hash before the passive effect subscribes to hashchange; a change in that interval can be lost. The source gap is confirmed; exact event timing is inferred from the failed scenario and snapshot.
fix: Capture the boot fragment; subscribe then compare current fragment and reconcile only if changed. Preserve automatic editor resumption for an unchanged empty fragment.
regression: Existing consecutive navigation unchanged; add deterministic event-before-subscription regression in all three browsers.
gatesAlreadyPassed: Live API and CORS for both default native nodes
OS-isolated standalone recovery in all three browsers

followup.cause: The editor normalizes optional empty fields at boot; the test compared this stored representation to an unnormalized legacy fixture.
followup.testOnlyCorrection: Capture the actual persisted draft immediately before the fragment event, require every original fixture field, then require exact before/after serialized equality.
